title: Main Rul Gayi Wich Bazaran De, Tu Baba Aakay
body:
Main Rul Gayi Wich Bazaran De, Tu Baba Aakay Vekh Zara
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Naizay Te Mera Parda, Ik Naizay Sir Veeran Da, Baba Akay Vekh Zara
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanay Da Kalma Parh Parh Ke,
Lokan Saanu Patthar Maare (x2)
Tera Jadh Vi Naam Mai Chaaya,
Sir Te Pathraan Daami Aaya, Baba Akay Vekh Zara
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaira Sir Towheed Layi Jhukkeya,
Onu Katteya Kalma Gowan (x2)
Naizay Te Jadh Aaya Qaari,
Mu Ton Hai Qur’aan Jaari, Baba Akay Vekh Zara
<<DIVIDER>>
Jairi Seenay Te Si Sohndi,
Rul Ke Mar Gayi Wich Zindaan De (x2)
Kevain Sabar Masuma Kargayi,
Baba Baba Kardi Mar Gayi, Baba Akay Vekh Zara
<<DIVIDER>>
Kevain Kitta Deen Mukammal,
Gal Te Shahid Sanad Nishaan Ay (x2)
Sab Kuch Waar Ke Yasrab Aayi,
Teri Dhi Ay Dard Satayi, Baba Akay Vekh Zara
